items.title: Tools plugin: the Tools section as its own plugin, with a Tools tab in Patches web
items.detail:
Brett, Oct 22 2026: the Tools section is a plugin of its own, and Claude handoff depends on it.

- New plugin `tools` (plugin@1 + lifecycle): it owns the Tools nav section and the top-level `tools` application menu that tool plugins add to; it provides a capability service (e.g. `axf.tools@1`) that tool plugins require.
- Claude handoff (and any later tool plugin) declares it as a dependency (`requires`) and adds its entries through it instead of creating the section itself.
- For Patches: the Tools plugin adds a **Tools** tab to Patches web's app tab group (next to Console / Pilot / axHub). Patches itself runs the Tools page; it is not the console page in a frame.
- Patches web only for now (Android later).

items.title: AmberX: hands-free listening on screen + in background, ActiveX-style detection overlay (level graph, dB, quick settings)
items.detail: Brett, Oct 27 2026 (claude.ai): 'It only detects words when I press speak' in AmberX (apps/amberx-droid). Cause: the native wake listener runs only while 'Watch axHub in the background' is on (default off) and pauses while the app is on screen. Fix: hands-free listening is its own setting (default on), works on screen and in the background, independent of axHub monitoring; optional always-armed (no wake phrase). Plus a detection overlay like ActiveX: floating draggable window over other apps with a moving audio-level line graph, decibel number, what was heard, and quick settings (listening on/off, always armed, hide). Colours from the app's theme tokens. Profile refactor, Opus (Brett's pick). Android exception: AmberX shell is allowed (rule Oct 25).
